prompt: Many believe that modern technology has brought people together, but others say that it has driven us apart. Discuss both viewpoints and give your own opinion.
essay:
The impact of modern technology on human relationships remains a subject of debate. While several people argue that it has strengthened social connections, others state that it causes isolation and weakened interpersonal bonds. In this essay, I will explore the arguments on both sides.

On the one hand, supporters of technological advancements contend that they have transformed the way people maintain relationships. In the past, letters and landlines were the only means of communication, which required a considerable time and money depending on the distance, whereas the modern developments in instant messaging, video calls, and social media allow individuals to connect across vast distances with minimal effort and cost. For instance, a daughter studying abroad in Poland can contact her family instantly, despite the geographical and time differences. Moreover, such platforms enable individuals to establish online communities with those sharing similar interests and ideologies, which would have been impossible through traditional methods. Consequently, social interactions have become more accessible and inclusive than ever before.

On the other hand, critics argue that social media causes isolation. As digital interaction becomes increasingly common, many people spend less time engaging in meaningful face-to-face conversations, which may weaken emotional connections. A clear example of this is those who are addicted to social media prioritising taking aesthetic pictures or scrolling reels instead of actively participating in deep discussions during hangouts. As a result, the interactions become less meaningful and more superficial. For such individuals, this can lead to loneliness, although they are constantly connected to others online. Therefore, it is crucial to utilise the technology to our own benefit.

To recapitulate, I firmly believe that modern technology has overall brought communities together by bridging distances and making communication more accessible, even though excessive addiction can diminish the quality of personal interactions.
